verdict.rationale: Fern's docs state that it generates API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification, and its CLI validates API definitions and publishes docs. However, nothing in the pack shows the reference automatically staying in sync when the spec changes; at best the CLI publish flow implies sync through manual regeneration. missing for 10: documented automatic re-sync on spec changes (e.g., CI/GitHub Action or watch-based regeneration), in-depth OpenAPI-to-reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, my API reference pages are generated from an OpenAPI spec and stay in sync when the spec changes

citations.quote: Fern supports writing pages in Markdown and generating API Reference documentation from an OpenAPI specification.
The Fern CLI lets you initialize projects, validate API definitions, preview changes locally, and publish documentation and SDKs.
Each version can contain its own tabs, sections, pages, and API references
